transcript.text: If you think about this as your
progress, so let's say this is 10 20 30
40 50 60 70 80% right? That's you
compared to the rest of the marketplace.
You get better this whole time and you
barely see any improvements in output.
But all the gains come from being the
top 10% to the top 5%. All of this gain
becomes yours. And you gain more from
getting from 95 to 97 and a half than
you did from everything up to 90.
Because fortunately, unfortunately, we
live in a winner-take-all society. And
so if you look at the top selling book
on Amazon, it sells more than the bottom
5.9 million books on Amazon. And so we
get outsize returns for incremental
improvements here. And the only way you
can get those incremental improvements
is saying no to everything that isn't
the one thing that matters most.
